name: Finance
description: The Spending page: spending, income and bills from a CSV of your transactions (a bank's export, or one an AI writes from your statements).
author: Vaultite

csv.label: Transactions file
csv.description: the transactions CSV, a vault path; left out, the vault's Transactions.csv (the one in a Finance folder first), wherever it is

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: the amounts' currency, a code like USD, EUR or BRL

bills.label: Bill categories
bills.description: the categories whose regular charges are bills; left out, any charge of about the same amount every month or so

spending.description: the range and account filter, then spending, income and net over it

range.description: a fixed range instead of the page's filter: all, 24m, 12m, 6m, 3m, ytd or YYYY-MM:YYYY-MM

account.description: one account instead of the page's filter (its name, as in the CSV)

spending-months.description: spending per month, stacked by category
